HTTP 播放同步保留原有歌曲、时间、响度与用户字段。

-- setup --
POST /music/pick
{
  "source": "wy",
  "id": "http-current",
  "user": {
    "name": "http-user"
  }
}

-- request --
POST /music/sync
{}

-- response --
200
{
  "type": "music",
  "url": "https://example.invalid/http-current",
  "webUrl": "",
  "pictureUrl": "",
  "duration": 3600000,
  "source": "netease",
  "lyric": "[00:00]lyric",
  "artist": "artist",
  "name": "同名歌曲",
  "album": "",
  "id": "http-current",
  "pushTime": 1,
  "volumeCoef": 0.75,
  "user": {
    "name": "http-user",
    "email": ""
  }
}
